name: claude-code-sound-alerts
description: Play sounds when Claude Code needs your input or finishes responding.

claudeSoundAlerts.enabled.description: Enable the local listener and sound alerts.

claudeSoundAlerts.serverPort.description: Localhost port used by Claude Code HTTP hooks. Reinstall hooks after changing this.

claudeSoundAlerts.questionSoundEnabled.description: Play the question sound when Claude needs your input.

claudeSoundAlerts.finishedSoundEnabled.description: Play the finished sound when Claude completes a response.

claudeSoundAlerts.alertOnAskUserQuestion.description: Alert immediately when Claude uses AskUserQuestion.

claudeSoundAlerts.alertOnPermissionReque.description: Alert immediately when Claude asks for tool permission.

claudeSoundAlerts.alertOnPlanApproval.description: Alert when Claude asks you to approve exiting plan mode.

claudeSoundAlerts.alertOnMcpElicitation.description: Alert when an MCP server asks for user input.

claudeSoundAlerts.alertOnBackgroundInput.description: Alert when a background Claude agent reports that it needs input.

claudeSoundAlerts.questionSoundPath.description: Optional path to a custom question/attention WAV file. Leave empty for the built-in sound.

claudeSoundAlerts.finishedSoundPath.description: Optional path to a custom finished WAV file. Leave empty for the built-in sound.

claudeSoundAlerts.debounceMs.description: Suppress duplicate alerts of the same type inside this time window.

claudeSoundAlerts.showVisualNotification.description: Also show a VS Code information notification when an alert fires.

claudeSoundAlerts.questionVolume.description: Question/attention sound volume from 0 to 100 percent.

claudeSoundAlerts.finishedVolume.description: Finished sound volume from 0 to 100 percent.
